theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2 with a high durability bar (0.78) and full breadth (1.0), suggesting trend-health and cohesion better than the fading leader. theses.dissent: Momentum ranks have ~zero rank-IC forward; Silver Miners is a cyclical precious-metals trade that mean-reverts hard if real yields rise or the AI-tech narrative reignites and drains attention from miners. Its hurst_tag is only 'mixed', not a clean trend.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The headline leader is internally deteriorating: val_state 'fading', r10 -0.126, durability_bar only 0.51, and breadth just 0.25 (the narrative is narrow, not broad).
